title: Kurepa left factorial
statement: For every odd prime p, the left factorial !p=sum(k!, k=0,…,p−1) is not divisible by p.

counterexample.description: An odd prime \(p\) with \(!p=\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}k!\equiv0\pmod p\). Primality plus the modular recurrence is exact, though checking costs roughly linear work in \(p\).
